text:
maria: Quick async check — onboarding triad-small weights to serving. Uploaded to gs://redwood-models/triad-small/v1/weights.tar.gz but noticed weird token deltas when using our chat template. Anyone seen duplicate BOS tokens in the prefix?
ajay: I saw something similar in local tests. When chat template starts with a fenced code block, tokenizer outputs an extra  token before the block.
sam: can you paste the minimal prompt and token ids?
maria: sure — minimal repro: 
```
USER: ```py
print(\"hi\")
```
```
Token ids around start: [50256, 50256, 35, ...] — 50256 is BOS for this tokenizer.
ajay: ugh that double 50256 is the cause. I think our tokenizer config expects to strip leading sentinels for chat templates but triad's vocab maps an extra sentinel to the fenced block.
taylor: is this a tokenizer model artifact or our chatfmt wrapper? did you try tokenizing raw content with the model's tokenizer vs our canonical wrapper?
maria: I compared both. Model tokenizer (from the repo weights) gives single BOS; our wrapper yields double. Repro steps: 
1) pip install -e ./triad_tokenizer
2) python -c "from triad_tokenizer import Tokenizer; print(Tokenizer().encode('USER: ```py
print(\"hi\")
```'))"
Got [50256, 50256, 35,...] with wrapper.
liz: possibility: wrapper has a prepend sentinel for chat role + we also call model's add_bos. Check config flag `chat.prepend_bos`.
ajay: yep check that. I remember a PR added `prepend_bos: true` to keep older models happy. For triad-small we probably need `prepend_bos: false`.
maria: logged a tiny PR to config repo: https://git.redwood/infra/configs/pull/428 — sets chat.prepend_bos=false for triad-small. CI runs now.
sam: aside — weights path: infra deploy is expecting a weights_manifest.json next to weights.tar.gz. You only uploaded tar.gz. ops-bot will complain at deploy time.
ops-bot: deploy-checker: missing file gs://redwood-models/triad-small/v1/weights_manifest.json — blocking.
maria: adding manifest now, thanks. Also, two quick questions for reviewers: 1) should we update tokenizer shim to detect fenced-block prefix and collapse duplicate BOS, or 2) prefer model-specific config tweak?
taylor: I prefer model-specific config if behavior is consistent across triad variants. Shim complexity can mask real tokenizer bugs.
ajay: agree. But also add a non-invasive shim with a telemetry flag so we can flip if more models surface this. We don't want silent token drops.
liz: for rollout plan: once PR merged, do a canary on ded-1 for small traffic, watch prefix token counts in console. Set alert if double-bos rate > 1%.
maria: noted. I updated rollout yaml in the PR to canary 5% with auto-rollback on token-drift alert. Config snippet: 
```yaml
models:
  triad-small:
    version: v1
    tokenizer_shim:
      collapse_duplicate_bos: false  # model-specific override
    chat:
      prepend_bos: false
```
ajay: pinged @sam for code-review on the shim change at https://git.redwood/eng/triad-tokenizer/pull/217 — small change, unit tests added.
sam: I'll review in next hour. Main thing: add test for fenced-block start and for normal freeform start. Also add check that we don't remove legitimate extra sentinels where model expects them.
maria: good call. one more oddity — when running eval prompts with trailing newline, our batching backend sometimes trims newline and that shifts tokens (EOS glue). Could be separate but wanted to flag: batching runtime uses `trim_trailing_newline: true`. Should we disable for this model?
ajay: if triad's tokenizer treats trailing newline as significant, set `trim_trailing_newline: false` in deployment config. Otherwise you'll see mismatch between eval and production.
liz: add that to the PR too and include a short eval-run after deploy.
maria: done — PR updated. CI passed. merging after sam review. Thanks all :rocket:
ops-bot: canary-deploy: started canary for triad-small:v1 on cluster ded-1 at 2405123930, 5% traffic.
taylor: I'll watch token-level telemetry and mark in #model-observability when we hit stable.
ajay: thumbs up. thanks for async triage, maria.
maria: thanks team — keeping an eye, will post results in this thread. :eyes:
